vibe_rationale: Community-run, hand-built beach cinema with curated film, music, art and food on the sand and brands woven in as culture, very close to SURPLUS in spirit.
fit_notes: Lifestyle-led Shonan beach and creative crowd with Tokyo day-trippers and a family day; age split is not published. Fourteen 2026 partners, including Hydro Flask, show brands are already woven in, and a sponsor Q&A page is published. The 15,000 figure dates from 2019, and the event is Japan-based, so an Australian brand would need a local partner.
